event.title: Flavors that Connect
event.subtitle: A NIGHT OF AFFECTIVE GASTRONOMY
intro: Bergamota and Lubisca are long-time friends. They carry memories, travels, laughter, and discoveries — many of them made around a table.
Now, they transform this friendship into a unique event: a night of nostalgic, affective gastronomy fermented with stories.
The proposal is simple: bring to the table flavors that marked their lives, mixed with technique, spontaneity, and a touch of boldness. It's food to remember, feel, and discover.
You are invited to live this experience.
closing: This event is more than a dinner: it's a meeting between memory and the present.
Between contemporary techniques and recipes that embrace.
Between two chefs who cook with history, soul, and friendship.
event.cta: Get ready to experience a night thought out in the smallest details — from the first bite to the last sip.

chefs.title: Who Cooks
chefs.together: Two friends. Two kitchens. One table.

bergamota.name: Bergamota
bergamota.description: Cooking is about rescuing what we didn't even know we had forgotten. In Dani's pots, there are memories of grandmothers, Sunday afternoons and the smell of wood-burning stoves. It's food that warms from the inside — and always asks for seconds.
bergamota.quote: Cooking is about rescuing what we didn't even know we had forgotten.

lubisca.name: Lubisca
lubisca.description: Time is the best ingredient. In Luiza's hands, it becomes flavor. Fermentation is not just technique: it's patience transformed into acidity, depth and surprise. Here, tradition meets experimentation — and the table is never the same.

manifesto.title: Manifesto
content: We believe that the table is a sacred place.
It doesn't matter if it's made of reclaimed wood or peeling Formica — what matters is who sits around it.
Food is not just nutrition. It's affection that you chew.
It's the smell that takes you back to childhood, the taste that becomes memory, the texture that makes you pause and feel.
This dinner is not just about what's on the plate. It's about the encounter.
About laughing, listening, slowing down. About being truly present — without rush, without performances.
We cook to tell stories. Ours, those who came before, those that will be born at this table.
We ferment patience. We sauté memories. We roast affection.
Here, tradition and experimentation share the same stove. The old is not discarded; the new is not forced.
Everything coexists, because real cooking is like that: alive, imperfect, generous.
May this dinner nourish you from within. May you leave different from how you came in.
And may, in the end, that 'I want more' feeling remain.
manifesto.quote: Food is not just nutrition. It's affection that you chew.
